column1: # Expected bytes and MD5 for every .cpfont in this directory.
# Why this file exists: the reader lists installed fonts by *filename only* —
# it never opens them — so a truncated copy (a GitHub "save link as" that
# grabbed the HTML page, an interrupted card write) still shows up in the
# font/size menu and only fails when selected. Compare against what the device
# actually holds, no card removal needed:
# The "size" of each file there must match the bytes column below.
